status_policy: The status field is derived by build() from the gates below; check() recomputes and compares. Missing status is fail-closed (not ready).

stages.T25a: Every T24 finding disposed into selected_fixed / non_blocking / invalid_measurement / post_1_0 with reason, owner and evidence; selected = 0 because the T24 ledger contains zero blocking findings.
stages.T25b: Zero-content three-axis closeout: no fixes applied, source-backed facts untouched, publication delta 0/0/0, no new registrations, T24 SKIP recheck contracts handed to T26.

closure_policy.reason: T25 is a zero-content close: the T24 ledger has zero blocking findings, so selected = 0 with complete dispositions; repository-wide verification is bound separately by the full snapshot report.
